title: [spec-gap][R-19-039] §13 string table (localization seam) unimplemented
description: spec/19-device-ux.md §13: all display text MUST come from a single string table keyed by IDs; v0.1 ships English only; the table is the localization seam; no on-device string construction beyond fixed formats (count, coordinates). Evidence: no string table exists anywhere (rg string_table/STR_TABLE across lichen/, rust/, python/src: only CBOR wire-key arrays in coap encoders, unrelated to display). Nothing renders text today, so this must land with or before the screen ring (b7z9.165) — building it as its own ID-keyed table module first keeps the localization seam from being bolted on later. Suggested placement: lichen/subsys/lichen/ux/ux_strings.c + generated ID header, host-testable like ux_button_core/ux_led_core.
close_reason: Implemented the spec 19 section 13 English ID-keyed UX string table, wired it into the UX library, and added invalid-ID and canonical-label host assertions. ux_button CMake build and ctest pass; fallback correctness/security/edge reviews found no defects after all three Kimi reviewer invocations failed with insufficient credits.
